name: HPLX
description: Glimmer, Spectral headings, and the warm light-and-shadow palette of the HPLX family.
identityNote: The approved Glimmer pairs a compact light above an enclosing shadow. Its geometry, Spectral lockups and complete family palette are the reference for HPLX interfaces and documents.
assetNote: Glimmer is the current identity. Ember and its platform icons are deprecated history; no current Glimmer platform icon pack is approved.
